title: Classes hold data and behavior together
objective: Declare a class with fields, a construction clause and methods, then create and use an object.

body.text: A class is for an object that keeps its own state and has an identity, such as a counter, a player or a document. Write class, then the name. Each has line declares a field, and each can line declares a method. Inside a method, myself means the object the method was called on. Use set and increase on its fields the same way you do on variables.

body.title: A counter with a method
body.code:
class counter
    has count of type number
    construction
        set count of myself to 0
    can bump
        increase count of myself by 1

make c equal to a new counter
bump c
bump c
say count of c

body.text: A construction clause runs when you write a new object, and it must set every field. Its inputs are written with takes, just like a function. Pass the values after with, the same way you name arguments in a function call.

body.title: Construction with an input
body.code:
class counter
    has count of type number
    has step of type number
    construction
        takes number called starting step
        set count of myself to 0
        set step of myself to starting step

make c equal to a new counter with starting step 2
say step of c

body.text: A method can take inputs too. Declare them with takes inside the can clause. Call the method by naming it, then the value, then to and the object, such as add 5 to c.

body.title: A method with an argument
body.code:
class counter
    has count of type number
    construction
        set count of myself to 0
    can add
        takes number called amount
        increase count of myself by amount

make c equal to a new counter
add 5 to c
say count of c

body.prompt: The counter is created but never used, so it stays at 0. Make the program print 1.
body.starter:
class counter
    has count of type number
    construction
        set count of myself to 0
    can bump
        increase count of myself by 1

make c equal to a new counter
say count of c
